content.text: Clear picture: latency spike at 22:29-22:34 correlates directly with pricing.io-internal.svc calls taking 1500ms for basket-total, going from 21/200 slow requests to 200/200 (all requests). This is an internal dependency (io-pricing, owned by checkout-platform, same org) failing/degrading, and no deployment/change occurred on io-shop itself.

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's p50/p95/p99 latency jumped at 22:29-22:30 in lockstep with logs showing the upstream pricing.io-internal.svc dependency taking 1500ms per call on basket-total requests, escalating from 21/200 to 200/200 requests affected. No code or config change occurred on io-shop in the preceding hours, and io-pricing is an internal dependency owned by the same organisation (checkout-platform).

supporting_evidence.claim: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-35697-6-0/basket-total (21 of 200 requests)
slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-40709-7-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
p50_ms jumps from 44 to 1545 and p95_ms from 209 to 1715 starting at the same minute
io-pricing: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at pricing.io-internal.svc - What a shopper's basket comes to once their discounts are applied. Called while the account page renders

hypotheses.summary: No cause could be confirmed beyond the dependency correlation - if io-pricing itself turns out healthy and the slowness is only an artifact of io-shop's own call path, no other explanation is supported by the retrieved evidence.
